title: Ever heard of keirin? I'm making a game about it
author: Novel-Cantaloupe8236
selftext:
Hey! I've been making a 3D game about keirin, Japanese track cycling, using Three.js with help from Claude and Codex.

You train your own rider and race. I've also been working on the tactics, like riders helping each other and blocking opponents, even though they're all competing for the win.

It's only in Japanese right now, since I originally made it for Japanese players. But I'm curious: have you heard of keirin before? Based on this clip, would you give it a try if it had English support?

Just curious to hear your first impressions!



It's free to play in your browser, but it's only in Japanese for now:  
[https://keirin-life.online/](https://keirin-life.online/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

comments.author: EffectNo2152
comments.body: cool idea is there english page?

replies.author: Novel-Cantaloupe8236
replies.body:
Thanks! No English version yet. Browser translation helps a bit, but the tutorial is still pretty basic too, so it might be confusing.  
If there's enough interest, I'll look into adding English support and making it easier to pick up for people who don't know keirin ;)
